finalText:
Found it. `processOrder.js` acquired a connection but released it only after `run()` succeeded — a bad order made `run()` throw, skipping the release. Each failed order leaked one connection, so the pool slowly filled up until it hit 5/5 and the worker started throwing `pool exhausted`, then gave up.

I wrapped the release in a `finally`, same pattern the request handler already used. All 4 tests pass now.
